# UX & Behavior Checklist: Reset View Button

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of requirements for the Reset view control (placement, accessibility, starting-view semantics, state isolation)
**Created**: 2026-11-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the button's visible form (text, icon, or both) specified, not only its accessible name? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK002 Is the button's position on the map (which corner/side) stated, rather than only "with existing controls"? [Gap, Spec §FR-007] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for the button's interaction states (hover, focus, active, disabled)? [Gap, Spec §FR-008] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK004 Is it specified whether the button is ever disabled or hidden (e.g., when already at the starting view)? [Gap, Spec §US1-4] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is "starting view" defined unambiguously, including the exact zoom value used for the first-position case? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK006 Is "visually consistent with existing map controls" measurable (size, style properties)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK007 Is "narrow mobile screens" quantified with a minimum supported width? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK008 Is the "first known position" defined (e.g., first fix regardless of accuracy)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Do the edge case for late location permission and FR-004 (starting view never changes after first fix) agree on when the view is fixed? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK010 Is the description of "wait for the initial view to settle" in User Story 1 consistent with FR-003's rule for when a position becomes known? [Consistency, Spec §US1] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK011 Can "under 2 seconds" be objectively measured given that the transition style is left open? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK012 Is a tolerance defined for "returns to the starting center and zoom" (exact vs. approximate)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK013 Can "announced with a meaningful name" be objectively verified, with the target assistive technologies named? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK014 Are requirements defined for pressing the button while a map animation or search-driven recentering is in progress? [Coverage, Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK015 Is behavior specified when a search result selection recenters the map (does it alter the starting view)? [Gap, Spec §FR-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK016 Is behavior defined when location is granted but the first fix never arrives? [Edge Case, Spec §US1-2] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK017 Are the rapid-repeat press requirements stated as testable outcomes? [Measurability, Spec §Edge Cases] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Non-Functional (Accessibility & Responsiveness)

- [x] CHK018 Are touch-target size requirements specified for the button? [Gap, Spec §FR-006] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK019 Are focus indicator visibility requirements specified beyond "visible"? [Clarity, Spec §US2-1] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements defined for how the button's name is exposed to non-English or localized contexts? [Gap, Spec §FR-006] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK021 Is the assumption that the starting view is not persisted across reloads validated against user expectations? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK022 Is the dependency on the existing one-time auto-centering behavior documented as a constraint? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK023 Is the list of state that must remain unchanged (FR-005) complete relative to the app's current state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-10
